programme_facts.value: You have an interest in both law and accounting and would like to pursue both subjects at University.
You like reading, and have an analytical mind. You like to solve problems, and are inquisitive.
You are also self-disciplined and motivated.
Graduates of Bachelor’s Degree in Law and Accounting are not prejudiced by virtue of their joint degree, and get the same exemptions as any graduate with a degree in Accounting.
